steps.text: Your net worth is what you own minus what you owe. Tap Coach, then Reports, and open Quarterly planning.
Tap Net Worth History, then Assets.
Your debts are already counted. To add something you own, tap the round button with the plus sign on it.
Type a name and what it's worth, and pick a category.
Your net worth updates right away. A snapshot is saved each month, so History shows how it changes over time.
